chapters.text: Give someone a bit more or less than their role without making a new role.
Settings → Users → open the person → Access exceptions.

Pick the app tab (CRM, HR, Finance…) or search for a feature. Each feature shows only the actions it has: Read, Add, Edit, Delete, Export… The tabs stay at the top while you scroll, with a row of links to each section (Leads, Deals, Calls…): click one to jump there.
Each box shows what their roles give (marked “role”). Choose another level — No access, Own only, Team, Branch or Everyone — to change just that permission; it turns amber and says “changed”.
Back to role undoes a feature's changes. Press Save access; it applies on their next page load.
